description:
Evaluate Altinity Cloud as a BenchBox platform target and record driver, SQL, and connection-limit facts.

Provision a trial Altinity Cloud cluster. Confirm clickhouse-connect over HTTPS :8443 and clickhouse-driver over native TCP :9440 against the trial endpoints. Record SELECT version() output, Altinity Stable Build version, auth model (user/password), and any DDL/DML deviation from open-source ClickHouse. Test Altinity Shield on/off behavior and record the added hop latency effect qualitatively. Confirm standard ClickHouse settings behavior (no gateway-style query rewriting).

Guardrails: trial credentials stay in env only, never committed; no benchmark data beyond SF 0.01 probe tables; read-only recon where possible.
